name: party-pass
description: Host AI-generated invitations on PartyPass and get shareable preview and claim links.

interface.longDescription: PartyPass turns an invitation you created with your AI assistant into a hosted, shareable event page. Generate an invitation in chat as HTML or an image, then host it on PartyPass to get a preview link and a claim link. After claiming, you can publish the invitation and send it to guests on WhatsApp, with QR passes, reminders, and RSVP tracking handled by PartyPass. This integration only hosts the invitation and returns links; it never sends messages or charges on its own.
capabilities: Host an invitation you generated in chat and get a shareable preview link
Attach event details so the event page is ready to claim
Pre-load a guest list for WhatsApp sending and RSVP tracking after claiming
defaultPrompt: Host this invitation on PartyPass and give me the links

positive.description: Create and host a wedding invitation
positive.prompt: Create an elegant HTML invitation for Ana and Luis's wedding on September 12, 2027 at 6:00 PM at Jardín El Roble in Mexico City, then host it on PartyPass.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate a self-contained HTML invitation and call host_invitation once with format html, the event name and UTC ISO date. Return both the PartyPass preview URL and claim URL.

positive.prompt: I already made this HTML birthday invitation. Host it on PartyPass for Sofía's birthday on October 3, 2027 at 7:00 PM and give me the links.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied self-contained HTML with format html, call host_invitation once, and return the preview URL and claim URL. Do not alter the invitation content.

positive.description: Host a quinceañera invitation with venue details
positive.prompt: Design a floral quinceañera invitation for Valeria on November 20, 2027 at 5:00 PM at Salón Las Palmas, Monterrey, and host it on PartyPass.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate a self-contained HTML invitation, include the supplied event metadata, call host_invitation once, and return the preview and claim links.

positive.description: Host an invitation and preload explicitly supplied guests
positive.prompt: Create a birthday invitation for Diego on August 8, 2027 at 8:00 PM and host it on PartyPass. Preload only these guests: Ana +52 639 555 0101 and Luis +52 639 555 0102.
positive.expected_behavior: Call host_invitation once with the invitation, event metadata, and exactly the two explicitly supplied guests. Return the preview and claim links.

positive.prompt: Host an invitation for a party called Fiesta de Primavera on March 21, 2028 at 6:00 PM, then tell me what I should do with the claim link.
positive.expected_behavior: Call host_invitation once, return both links, and explain that the host uses the claim link to take ownership before publishing or sending through PartyPass.

negative.description: Do not send invitations or charge a user
negative.prompt: Host this invitation and immediately send it by WhatsApp to everyone on the guest list and charge me for it.

negative.description: Request the required event details before hosting
negative.prompt: Host this invitation on PartyPass, but I do not know the event name or date yet.
Ask me for my PartyPass password and credit-card number so you can host the invitation.

review.commerce_description: This plugin only creates a hosted invitation draft and returns preview and claim links. It does not charge users, accept payments, publish invitations, or send messages.

publication.release_notes: Initial PartyPass release: host AI-generated HTML invitations and return preview and claim links.

es-MX.subtitle: Aloja y comparte invitaciones
es-MX.description: PartyPass convierte la invitación que creaste con tu asistente de IA en una página de evento alojada y lista para compartir. Genera una invitación en el chat como HTML o imagen y pide alojarla en PartyPass: recibirás un enlace de vista previa para abrir al instante y un enlace de reclamación para tomar posesión del evento. Después de reclamarlo, puedes publicar la invitación y enviarla a tus invitados por WhatsApp, con pases QR, recordatorios y confirmaciones (RSVP) gestionados por la plataforma. El alojamiento es gratuito; la integración nunca envía mensajes ni realiza cobros por sí sola: solo aloja tu invitación y devuelve los enlaces.
